name: site-shot-mcp
description: Website screenshots for AI agents: real Chromium, full-page capture, ISO-code country proxies, automatic ad & cookie-banner removal.
long_description: Official MCP server for the Site-Shot screenshot API. Gives Claude, Cursor, and other AI agents the ability to see any web page: real Chromium rendering, full-page (scrolling) capture up to 20,000 px, country-specific proxies with matching language/time zone/geolocation, and automatic ad + cookie-banner removal enabled by default for cleaner images and fewer vision tokens. Country is a two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code ("DE", not "Germany"), and a country with no proxy available returns an error rather than silently falling back to a US proxy — pass strict_country: false for the old fallback behaviour. Requires a Site-Shot API key; test output quality first with the free, no-signup browser tool at https://www.site-shot.com/.

api_key.title: Site-Shot API key
api_key.description: Your Site-Shot API key (userkey). Get one at https://www.site-shot.com/pricing/ — the free no-signup browser tool does not issue keys.

tools.name: capture_screenshot
tools.description: Capture a screenshot of a web page (viewport or full-page) with ad and cookie-banner removal on by default. Optional country proxy takes a two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code such as "DE".

tools.name: capture_full_page
tools.description: Capture a full-page scrolling screenshot of a web page (up to 20,000 px tall). Optional country proxy takes a two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code such as "DE".
